title: 2025 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Yazeed Al-Rajhi  /  Timo Gottschalk (Overdrive Racing) and Daniel Sanders (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing)
summary: The 2025 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 8 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Yazeed Al-Rajhi  /  Timo Gottschalk (Overdrive Racing); Bikes: Daniel Sanders (Red Bull KTM Factory Racing); Challenger: Nicolás Cavigliasso  /  Valentina Pertegarini (Team BBR); SSVs: Brock Heger  /  Max Eddy (Sebastien Loeb Racing – RZR Factory Racing); Trucks: Martin Macík  /  František Tomášek  /  David Švanda (MM Technology).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
